5D bulk SU3L x U1X plus colour SU3. Dirac Q=(3c,bar3L,1/3),D=(3c,3L,0); TeV-brane RH UR=(3c,1,2/3). TeV-brane Sigma=(1,3L,1/3) complex; optional Planck-brane S same weak/X rep. All source fermions colour3; bulk Lorentz B2spinor distinct from brane4D RH. Source restricts displayed construction to third-generation quarks.

UV scalar breaking can be replaced by boundary conditions; one optional realization adds brane URprime,DLprime,DRdoubleprime to remove unwanted modes. Gauge-Higgs unification alternative uses A5 as PGB, not a separate elementary scalar doublet. Brane/bulk inventories and alternatives cannot be unioned.

Quartic mediator is actual 5D bulk complex scalar Phi in SU3L symmetric6 with X=2/3, coupled Sigma Phi-dagger Sigma on TeV brane. Thus DynkinA2[2,0],colour singlet by the displayed invariant.
